title: Using Kamailio as SBC for Microsoft Teams
html:
Henning Westerholt, one of the project’s core developers, published a tutorial on how to use Kamailio as SBC (Session Border Controller) for Microsoft Teams. The blog post can be found at:

  • https://skalatan.de/blog/kamailio-sbc-teams

In this way you can extend the MS Teams systems with the features that Kamailio provides, especially for SIP trunking, interconnecting with VoIP providers or connecting external SIP endpoints.
